name: pr-tracker
description: Side pane listing the PRs opened in the session (subagents included), grouped by task key, with live state, review and CI

jiraBaseUrl.title: Jira browse URL
jiraBaseUrl.description: Prefix for task keys, e.g. https://<site>.atlassian.net/browse/. Empty: task keys are not links.

extraPrCommand.title: Extra PR-opening command (regex)
extraPrCommand.description: Regex matching a command other than gh pr create / gh api that opens PRs, e.g. your own script. Empty: gh only.

ignoredPendingChecks.title: Ignored pending checks (regex)
ignoredPendingChecks.description: Regex for check names that stay pending forever and should not hold the CI badge. Empty: none.
